Name: Chimchar over Dog
Author: LothlanEmber
Description:
I've taken some sprites from Pokemon Mystery Dungeon Explorers and made them into a working mod that no longer needs to replace the .xnb files. All you need is Content Patcher and you get a cute little Chimchar excited to see you every day. 

It even comes with it's own icon on the your inventory menu to complete the adoption.

Downloads.Description: Chimchar from Mystery Dungeon replaces dog with a custom icon.

Manifest.Name: Chimchar Over Dog
Manifest.Description: Changes the first dog option into Chimchar.
